title: Navisworks Coordination Container Federation Integrity
test_intent: Determine whether a Navisworks coordination container is sufficiently complete, aligned, and traceable for downstream clash execution or formal coordination review.

applicability.applies_when: The tested subject is a Navisworks coordination container used for governed clash execution, coordination review, or coordination evidence.
applicability.not_applicable_when: The Navisworks file is an ad-hoc personal review artifact not used for governed coordination.

required_evidence: coordination container identity and declared coordination scope
included source-model list and identifiable source versions
configuration or profile identity sufficient to reproduce the coordination state

result_logic.pass: The required source models and versions are identifiable, references are valid, governed coordinate alignment is confirmed, applicable governed sets are available, and the coordination configuration is reproducible for the declared scope.
result_logic.fail: A required source is missing or untraceable, coordinate alignment is invalid, references are broken, required governed sets are absent, or configuration inconsistency makes the coordination result unreliable.
result_logic.not_applicable: The subject is not used for governed coordination.
result_logic.indeterminate: Available evidence is insufficient to establish federation completeness, coordinate alignment, reference integrity, or configuration consistency.

provenance.migration_note: Conformance object derived from the migrated Navisworks setup requirement. Exact software toggles and project tolerances remain outside this abstract test.
